title: 12 Best Photography Spots in Chengdu
description: Discover Chengdu's top 12 photography spots! From iconic pandas to ancient temples, vibrant street scenes, and modern skylines, capture the best of Chengdu. Plan your photo adventure now!

places.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Giant pandas in various poses: eating bamboo, climbing trees, or playing. Focus on capturing their expressions and natural behaviors.

places.name: Jinli Ancient Street
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Red lanterns illuminating traditional wooden buildings, street performers, local snack vendors, reflections on wet cobblestones after rain.

places.name: Kuanzhai Alley (Wide and Narrow Alleys)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ornate doors and windows, tea ceremonies, street artists, local residents enjoying tea, modern art installations blended with old walls.

places.name: Daci Temple & Taikoo Li
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Reflections of the temple in Taikoo Li's modern buildings, monks walking amidst luxury stores, the grand temple gates against the urban backdrop.

places.name: Wuhou Shrine Museum
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ornate temple roofs, ancient cypress trees, traditional courtyards, statues of historical figures, reflections in the ponds.

places.name: People's Park (Renmin Park)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Tea house patrons, ear-cleaning vendors, match-making corner activity, traditional Sichuan opera performers (sometimes), boat rides on the lake.

places.name: Anshun Bridge (Xinnanmen Bridge)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The illuminated bridge reflecting on the river, passing boats with light trails, the bridge's intricate design against the city skyline.

places.name: Eastern Suburb Memory (Dongjiao Jiyi Cultural & Creative Industries Park)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grungy factory walls, vibrant street art murals, unique sculptures, vintage trains, artists and performers in action.

places.name: Sichuan University (Wangjiang Campus)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The grand main gate, ancient banyan trees, reflections in the campus lakes, students going about their day, classic university architecture.

places.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage Museum
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Thatched roof cottages, bamboo forests, koi ponds, intricate garden pathways, stone steles with calligraphy.

places.name: Wangjianglou Park (Wangjiang Tower Park)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dense bamboo forests, the majestic Wangjiang Tower, reflections of the tower in the river, various types of bamboo species.

places.name: Qingyang Palace (Green Ram Temple)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The two bronze green rams, detailed roof carvings, Taoist practitioners, incense smoke, vibrant temple colors.
